function login(){
userInfo=source.getLoginInfoMap()
UNE=userInfo['手机号码/邮箱号']
PWD=userInfo['密码']
url="https://"+getUrl('爱发电')+"/api/passport/login,";

body={

  "password": String(PWD),
  "mp_token": -1
}
option={
'method': 'POST',
'body': JSON.stringify(body)
}

url=url+JSON.stringify(option);
let ajaxData = java.ajax(url);
let jsonData = JSON.parse(ajaxData);

token=jsonData?.data?.auth_token;

let msg = jsonData.em;
if(token==undefined){
    throw new Error(msg);
}

Cookie={
	"Cookie":"auth_token="+token
	}
header = JSON.stringify(Cookie)
source.putLoginHeader(header)
}

function select(i){
	try{
	putUrl(i);
	let s = source.getVariable();
	let urlData = JSON.parse(s);
	let data = urlData.data;
	urlData.index = i;
	let t = data[i].t;
	java.toast("当前源站切换为：\n"+t);
	source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(urlData));
	}catch(e){java.log(e)}
	}
</js>

    var parts = rawHtml.split('\n');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        var line = parts[i].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (line) {
            if (/最新网址|m\.biqukun|本章未完.*继续阅读/.test(line)) continue;
            lines.push(line);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length > 0 && /^第\d+章/.test(lines[0])) {
        lines.shift();
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

var html = String(result);
var doc = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var content = doc.selectFirst('div.TxtContent');
var lines = [];
if (content) {
    var ps = content.select('p');
    for (var i = 0; i < ps.size(); i++) {
        var t = String(ps.get(i).text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (t && !/温馨提示|本章.*完.*继续阅读|wjzxchina/.test(t)) {
            lines.push(t);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length === 0) {
        var text = String(content.text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (text) lines.push(text);
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

jsLib:
time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?\d+/,'$1')
.replace(/^(\d+)、/,'第$1章 ')
.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?第.+章/,'$1')
.replace(/第\s(.+)\s章/,'第$1章')

.replace(/\(.+\)/,'')
.replace(/\[|。/,'')
